# The Mystical World of Spells
This feature is: [color=orange]In-Progress[/color].
Where magic exists, spells follow. And with the use of spells, comes great accountability.
## Accessing your spells
In order to access your spell memory, you may press 'L' by default. Any living being can access this. You will notice two sections; the [color=green]learned spells[/color], and the [color=yellow]active spells[/color].
Your total spell capacity is your learned plus active spells. That's how many spells you can 'remember' at any moment.
- The [color=green]learned spells[/color] are simply a backlog of spells that can be used. - The [color=yellow]active spells[/color] are spells that can currently be used by the magic user.
In order to move a spell from the learned category, to the active one, and vice versa, you must press the respective spell by clicking it.
There is also a small UI element on your HUD, at the bottom left of your screen. That element displays your current active spell. As you may have noticed, you can only use one active spell at a time.
If you have many spells in the [color=yellow]active category[/color], you may press 'pgup' and 'pgdown' by default, to go to the next, or previous active spell.
## Using spells
Let's use assume you have an active spell on. Firstly, you'll need a spellcasting item. An item that basically grants you the ability to cast spells. You can't just fire off spells with your bare hands.
Once you have that item in your hand, press 'middle-click' by default to cast the spell.
Simple!
## Diving deeper
Spells are usually categorized into various "types". Most common folk will encounter "dumb spells", which are spells of no huge importance.
However, via magic research, individuals can acquire specialized spells.
